verdict.rationale: vLLM installs as a Python package (pip/uv) and offers in-process offline inference via Python. Its server exposes an OpenAI-compatible API (plus Anthropic Messages and gRPC), so developers can call it through existing OpenAI client libraries, which a community user confirms works with ChatGPT applications. However, the evidence shows no vLLM-branded official client SDKs; remote access relies on third-party OpenAI/Anthropic clients. Missing for 10: an official vLLM client library for calling the server, any JavaScript client, and documentation of a client SDK.
